UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered Plus AI user account with plan tier, daily message credits, 24h cycle tracking, and visit count.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the sidebar and admin subscriptions table.

dailyLimit.description: Daily renewable message allowance for this user (default 3).

remainingCredits.description: Current remaining message credits available for this user.

cycleStartedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when the current 24h renewal cycle started.

lastResetDate.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD key of the last credit cycle reset.

totalUsed.description: Total AI messages consumed by the user.

visitsCount.description: Total app sessions recorded for this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last account update.

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent visit or activity.

UserChat.title: UserChat
UserChat.description: Private conversation belonging exclusively to a single signed-in Plus AI user account.

id.description: Chat identifier matching the document ID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

title.description: Conversation title displayed in the user's sidebar.

messages.description: Ordered list of conversation turns (bounded to 300 entries).

createdAtMs.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when the chat started.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the most recent message or rename.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last chat update.

SiteAnalytics.title: SiteAnalytics
SiteAnalytics.description: Global site visits and registered user counters readable exclusively by the admin.

totalVisits.description: Cumulative app visits recorded across sessions.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last counter update.

ModelQuotaAnalytics.title: ModelQuotaAnalytics
ModelQuotaAnalytics.description: Global per-model daily usage counters over a rolling 24-hour cycle (Plus Plus out of 200, Plus out of 10000).

cycleStartedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp when the current 24h global capacity cycle started.

plusPlusUsed.description: Cumulative messages consumed today on Plus Plus (gemini-4-hydrogen) out of 200.

plusUsed.description: Cumulative messages consumed today on Plus (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) out of 10000.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last model usage counter update.

/users/{uid}.description: Per-user account profiles, daily 3-message credit balances, subscription plans, and visit counters.

/users/{uid}/chats/{chatId}.description: Per-user private chat history strictly isolated to the owning user UID.

/analytics/{docId}.description: Global app analytics documents: /analytics/site (visits & users) and /analytics/quota (per-model daily usage counters).
